## Overview

`rsdv` generates synthetic tabular data from a real dataset. The three-step
workflow is: *describe → fit → sample*.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(rsdv)

set.seed(42)

meta <- metadata(adult_income) |>
  set_column_type("age",    "numerical") |>
  set_column_type("income", "categorical")

syn   <- gaussian_copula_synthesizer(meta)
syn   <- fit(syn, adult_income)
synth <- sample(syn, n = 500)
```

## Evaluating synthetic data quality

```{r, warning=FALSE}
qr <- quality_report(adult_income, synth, meta)
print(qr)
```

## Evaluating privacy

```{r, warning=FALSE}
pr <- privacy_report(adult_income, synth)
print(pr)
```

## Adding constraints

```{r}
meta2 <- meta |>
  add_constraint(inequality_constraint("age", "education_num", type = "gt"))
```
